snippet.title: EvoBorn
snippet.description: A creature raising and battling PC game I am working on. It also has elements of a Survival game, and a Roguelike game. Raise your creature from an egg to defend yourself against the robot machines. They will hunt the player every 5 days and also become stronger every 5 days. How many days can you last?
